in_marathi.name: Neerja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neerja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Neer', meaning 'water'. The suffix 'ja' denotes the giver or provider. Neerja is a name for a calm and composed female, often associated with water and its soothing qualities.
